definition: The task of automatically generating a natural language description of the contents of an image.
details: Image captioning combines visual understanding with language generation, and is a classic benchmark task for evaluating multimodal models that must connect visual and textual representations.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. And that is Image Captioning — giving a machine the gift of sight.
